concept: MongoDB advanced explain: aggregation spills, sharded plans, loose index scans and the cost-based ranker
summary: Advanced explain output covers spill statistics for blocking aggregation stages (usedDisk, spilledBytes and the per-stage memory limit), sharded plans (SHARD_MERGE, splitPipeline with shardsPart and mergerPart, mergeType), the $sort+$group $first loose index scan that explain reports as DISTINCT_SCAN, and the 8.3 cost-based ranker with its costEstimate and cardinalityEstimate fields. Compiled from MongoDB manual and JIRA pages plus the run's verified claims.
title: MongoDB advanced explain: aggregation spills, sharded plans, loose index scans and the cost-based ranker
